source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20
extraction_note: Screener.in, BSE/NSE archives and company IR sites were unreachable from this run's network sandbox; all 20 entries were built from web-search snippets only (confidence Low).

china_plus_one.evidence: A broker note puts exports at roughly 70% of sales. A TradeBrains summary of the FY26 Integrated Annual Report says CDMO exports were over 96% of that segment's revenue; CDMO revenue grew 59% in FY26 (PL Capital). The China+1 framing comes from third-party commentary (DSIJ, Jun 2026, citing China-plus-one sourcing); no explicit company attribution of growth to China+1 was found in the snippets. Domestic share is derived as 100 minus 70.

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports are about 70% of sales per a broker note (secondary source, approximate); used as a proxy for foreign-currency revenue. FY26 consolidated revenue was about Rs 3,314 Cr, up 41% YoY. No hedging policy was found in the search results.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI approval for Navin Fluorine was found in search results.

china_plus_one.evidence: Per a third-party summary of FY2024-25 data, India is about 85% of revenue and international about 15% (FY24: India 86% per Simply Wall St). The FY26 split was not found. The FY26 AR shareholder letter talks about aggressively expanding the global footprint and building customers across Europe, North America and Southeast Asia, and management expects exports to become a 'meaningfully larger' share in 3-5 years. Export momentum in switches, lighting and sensors was cited in Q1FY26. No explicit China+1 narrative was found.

inr_exposure.evidence: International revenue is about 15% per a third-party FY2024-25 geography summary; the FY26 figure was not found. FY26 consolidated revenue was Rs 19,658 Cr (+17%). Overseas revenue includes overseas subsidiaries (e.g. Uno Minda Europe GmbH), so it is not all USD.

pli_scheme.evidence: A Ministry of Heavy Industries parliamentary reply (as of 30.11.2025) lists UNO Minda Limited and Denso Ten Uno Minda India Pvt Ltd as Component Champion beneficiaries under the auto PLI scheme. Minda Industries (the former name) was on the 2022 approval list. PLI incentive revenue was not quantified.

china_plus_one.evidence: Per FY26 investor presentation coverage (Investywise, Autocar Pro), Royal Enfield international revenue was about Rs 3,288 Cr. That is about 14% of consolidated revenue of Rs 23,408 Cr (derived estimate; one source shows Rs 8,288 Cr, likely a typo). RE export volumes rose 20% to 120,634 units, about 9.8% of RE volume. Brazil is the largest international market, and a Mexico CKD plant is being evaluated. The export growth is brand-led; no China+1 narrative was found.

govt_capex.evidence: VECV (trucks and buses) is exposed to infrastructure and freight cycles; management projects single-digit VECV growth in FY27. No revenue % linked to government capex was disclosed in the snippets.

inr_exposure.evidence: Derived estimate: RE international revenue of about Rs 3,288 Cr out of Rs 23,408 Cr FY26 consolidated revenue is about 14%. Angel One separately says overseas operations are about 15% of revenue. No hedging policy was found.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI approval for Eicher, RE or VECV was found. A 2021 report said VECV planned to tap auto PLI via the EV route, but no approval was confirmed.

china_plus_one.evidence: This is a domestic diagnostics business. International operations (Nepal subsidiary, Bangladesh subsidiary at 71.83%, new Dubai subsidiary not yet operating) are under 2% of revenue per a Ventura Securities FY25 summary, so 2% is an upper-bound estimate. FY26 domestic regional split: Delhi NCR 31%, UP & UK 19%, Rest of North 13%, East 15%, West 14%, South 6%, Others 2%.

rural.evidence: Tier 3+ towns were about 39% of FY26 revenue (Rs 1,090 Cr of Rs 2,763 Cr), up from 34% in FY23, per the investor presentation (Multibagg coverage). This is a small-town measure, not a strictly rural one, so revenue_pct is left null.

inr_exposure.evidence: International revenue is under 2% (Nepal/Bangladesh, local currencies), so there is negligible USD revenue.

china_plus_one.evidence: No FY26 export share of revenue was found. The Dubai plant contributed about 8% of total volume in Q2FY26 (Quartr earnings summary). In Q2FY24, management cited about 100k t of export volume and targeted international at about 10% of business by FY27. FY26 commentary lists 'international growth' as a focus. No China+1 narrative was found.

govt_capex.evidence: FY26 demand was supported by construction and infrastructure: structural tubes go into housing, commercial buildings, airports, railway stations and warehouses (BigMint FY26 industry report). No govt-capex revenue % was disclosed. FY26 revenue was Rs 23,079 Cr on 3.49 Mt volume.

crude_exposure.evidence: The key raw material is HRC steel (realisations were linked to HRC prices in FY26), not crude. No crude-linked raw material % was disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: The Dubai plant was about 8% of volume in Q2FY26, but no revenue share or hedging policy was disclosed in the snippets.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI approval for APL Apollo was found in search results.

china_plus_one.evidence: Per FY26 directors' report coverage: India became largest end market at 51% of revenue (vs 29% in FY25); Eastern markets incl. India and China were 56% (vs 35%). FY25 mix was North America 41%, India 29%, Europe 24%, Asia 6%. Management said on Q3FY26 call that North America 'has nearly halved'. Exports shrank as a share; no explicit China+1 narrative found in snippets. FY26 North America/Europe shares not found (H1FY26: NA 30%; Q1FY27: NA 26%, Europe 15%, China 9%).

inr_exposure.evidence: Derived estimate: overseas revenue ~49% of FY26 revenue (100% minus India's 51% per FY26 directors' report coverage); currency split not disclosed in snippets. FY26 revenue ~Rs 4,475 Cr (+26% YoY). No hedging disclosure found.

pli_scheme.evidence: Sona BLW is among 67 companies approved under Auto PLI Component Champion category; first component maker to receive PLI certification (Feb 2024, e-2W hub wheel motor) and received certification for three more products in Aug 2025. Incentive amount/revenue share not found.

china_plus_one.evidence: Per FY26 coverage (Whalesbook): management said overseas markets are ~8% of total sales value; exports hit a record in FY26 helped by Gulf recovery and strength in Africa and Asia-Pacific; exports span 100+ countries. No China+1 / supply-chain diversification angle (alcobev brand exports).

crude_exposure.evidence: Raw materials are agri-based (grain, molasses, ENA), not crude-linked. FY26 raw material cost ~Rs 3,343 Cr vs net sales ~Rs 6,050 Cr (~55%, derived from data-site figures); packaging (glass) share not disclosed. Dual-feed UP distillery reduces reliance on external molasses.

inr_exposure.evidence: Per FY26 coverage: overseas markets ~8% of total sales value (currency split not disclosed). Separate report cites Gulf at 9-10% of revenue, which conflicts; treat as approximate. No hedging disclosure found.

china_plus_one.evidence: IT services exporter; no China+1 narrative. FY26 mix per Q4FY26 results coverage: Americas 56.9% (Rs 93,344 mn), EMEA 28.9% (Rs 47,425 mn), Rest of World 14.2% (Rs 23,258 mn) of Rs 164,027 mn revenue. 'export_us_pct' holds the Americas segment and 'export_europe_pct' holds EMEA; RoW includes India, whose share is not separately disclosed, so domestic/export split left null (exports are the large majority).

rate_sensitive.evidence: Q4FY26 broker review notes a USD 550 mn dollar-denominated loan taken in India (acquisition-related); floating-rate share not disclosed.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Uses forward/derivative hedges on foreign-currency revenue; USD 550 mn USD loan acts as natural hedge. Hedge gains/losses reclassified from revenue to other income in FY26. Q1FY27 review: hedge loss US$10 mn in quarter, MTM loss US$14 mn on outstanding hedges; no open hedge book expected beyond Q3FY27.
inr_exposure.evidence: Per Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 broker reviews (Baroda/IDBI). Americas + EMEA = 85.8% of FY26 revenue; currency-level (USD/GBP/EUR) split not found, so usd_revenue_pct left null.

china_plus_one.evidence: IT services exporter; no China+1 narrative. Per FY26 results coverage (Multibagg): North America 80.6% of FY26 revenue; Europe 8.1% and India 8.3% are Q4FY26 shares (full-year not found) so domestic/export split is a derived estimate. FY26 USD growth: NA 17.2%, Europe 26.7%, India 9.5%, RoW 27.5%; FY26 revenue US$1,654.4 mn.

inr_exposure.evidence: North America (proxy for USD revenue) 80.6% of FY26 revenue per results coverage; actual currency split not disclosed in snippets. No hedging disclosure found.

china_plus_one.evidence: Per FY25 directors' report: standalone export sales INR 14,054 mn (vs 12,790 mn FY24), ~8.3% of product sales INR 169,316 mn (derived). Q1FY27 summary puts exports at ~8-8.5% of revenue with plans to raise the share (e.g., NOx sensors). Exports largely intra-Bosch-group; no explicit China+1 narrative. FY26 AR is published but its export line was not found, hence FY2024-25 figures.

rural.evidence: FY25 Powertrain Solutions growth (5.8%) was driven largely by the tractor segment and exports; rural/tractor revenue share not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: Export sales ~8.3% of FY25 standalone product sales (derived: INR 14,054 mn / 169,316 mn); currency split not disclosed. FY25 revenue from operations INR 180,874 mn (+8.1%); FY26 INR 20,035 Cr (+10.8%).

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI approval for Bosch Ltd found in search results; not confirmed.

china_plus_one.evidence: Trent is a domestic apparel/lifestyle retailer: per FY2025-26 Integrated Annual Report coverage (scanx.trade), it had 1,286 stores at 31 Mar 2026 (300 Westside, 963 Zudio, 23 other). The only overseas presence is 6 Zudio stores in the UAE via a subsidiary. No export business and no China+1 narrative found. International revenue share not disclosed, but it is negligible.

rural.evidence: Store additions in FY26 were skewed to the value format Zudio (+198 net stores), which is expanding into smaller cities. No rural or tier-2/3 revenue split found in search snippets.

rate_sensitive.evidence: A Trading Economics snippet lists FY26 debt of about INR 25.6B, probably including lease liabilities (unverified). No floating-rate share disclosed in search results.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY26 consolidated revenue was INR 20,074 Cr against standalone INR 19,701 Cr, so overseas subsidiaries such as the UAE stores contribute very little. Foreign-currency revenue not disclosed.

china_plus_one.evidence: Per DSIJ analysis, FY25 international sales were about INR 57.5 Cr out of INR 2,066.9 Cr total revenue (just under 3%). The FY26 split was not found, so the split shown is on an FY25 basis and is an estimate. Priority overseas markets are Bangladesh, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand and the UAE/GCC (UAE subsidiary Honasa Consumer General Trading LLC) (Inc42). No China+1 narrative.

rural.evidence: Offline distribution is expanding, but no rural revenue split was found. FY26 consolidated revenue was about INR 2,392 Cr (+15.7%), or INR 2,479 Cr like-for-like before a Flipkart settlement accounting change.

inr_exposure.evidence: International revenue is about 3% of the total (FY25, per DSIJ). No currency split or hedging policy found.

china_plus_one.evidence: FY26 consolidated revenue was INR 33,653 Cr (+6.1%). US formulations were INR 14,408 Cr (-2.7%), about 43% of revenue per the FY26 directors' report. Europe formulations were INR 10,315 Cr (+23.4%, crossing EUR 1bn), Growth Markets INR 3,499 Cr (+10%), ARV INR 1,384 Cr (+33.5%) and API INR 4,047 Cr (-6.4%), per financialreports.eu and IIFL. The export figure is a derived lower bound: the 88% is the formulations total excluding API, and it ignores API exports, so domestic share is not disclosed. Export_other is Growth Markets plus ARV. On China+1, the Pen-G plant at Kakinada was set up under PLI and began production on 1 Jul 2025 for backward integration away from imported (China) fermentation intermediates. Growth is not explicitly attributed to China+1.

inr_exposure.evidence: Per the FY26 directors' report (IIFL), the US is 43% of total revenue. Europe is about 31% more, which is EUR-linked (derived: 10,315/33,653). No hedging policy found in search snippets.

pli_scheme.evidence: Subsidiary Lyfius Pharma built a Penicillin-G plant at Kakinada SEZ under the bulk-drug PLI scheme. Production started 1 Jul 2025. Management cites a 7,000-8,000 t PLI target with estimated incentives of about INR 150 Cr and 50-100 bps of cost savings. PLI revenue % not disclosed.

china_plus_one.evidence: FY26 consolidated NSV was INR 12,467 Cr (+7.7%) and standalone NSV INR 12,448 Cr, so the business is essentially India-focused (Diageo India release). The India-UK FTA is flagged as a tailwind, mainly for imported Scotch input costs and premium labels. No export split disclosed and no China+1 narrative.

crude_exposure.evidence: Key inputs are ENA (grain/molasses-based) and glass bottles, not crude. FY26 coverage (Sahi) notes 7-10% ENA cost inflation offset by glass recycling and productivity. Raw-material % not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: No foreign-currency revenue or hedging disclosure found. FX exposure is mainly on imported Scotch/malt inputs (not quantified).

china_plus_one.evidence: FY26 revenue from operations was INR 27,148 Cr (+16.8%). The split is on a Q4FY26 basis, not full year: North America formulations were about 40% of Q4 revenue (INR 2,952 Cr, -5.7% YoY) per the Screener summary. A May-2026 broker note gives India (formulations plus consumer) at 42% of sales. Export_pct is derived as 100-42. Growth was led by India/EM and consumer wellness (FY26 consumer segment INR 3,954 Cr, including the acquired business), with the US/API offsetting. No China+1 narrative found.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Coverage flags a sharp rise in net debt in FY26 after acquisitions (Whalesbook, IndiaMedToday). Floating-rate share not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: North America formulations were about 40% of Q4FY26 revenue (quarterly proxy, not full year). No hedging policy found.

pli_scheme.evidence: A Parliament reply (eparlib.nic.in) lists Zydus Lifesciences among domestic applicants that have availed incentives under Categories 1 and 3 of the PLI scheme for Pharmaceuticals. Amount and revenue % not disclosed.

china_plus_one.evidence: Per FY26 BRSR coverage (ScanX): exports ~85% of revenue from operations, customers in ~50 countries; FY26 consolidated revenue Rs 21,243 Mn (+15.2%). Regional mix in snippets is from other periods only: DRHP-era (FY25) Europe ~38% / North America ~26% (Substack); PL Research Q2FY27 note cites Europe ~60%, US 20-24%. No explicit China+1 attribution found in snippets.

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports ~85% of FY26 revenue from operations (FY26 BRSR, standalone, per ScanX); DRHP: exports 83.44% of FY25 revenue, billed mainly in USD/EUR, flagged as FX risk. Hedging policy not found in snippets.

china_plus_one.evidence: FY25 BRSR: exports 51.7% of turnover (FY26 BRSR export figure not retrievable from snippets). FY26 revenue ~Rs 2,552 Cr (+6.9%); non-GPL business (71% of revenue) grew 13% led by India, Europe, ROW, Japan, LATAM. Market diversification but no explicit China+1 narrative found.

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports 51.7% of FY25 turnover per FY2024-25 BRSR (used as overseas-revenue proxy). Hedging policy not found.

china_plus_one.evidence: Hospitality business; no export/China+1 narrative. International hotels (US, UK, Maldives, Dubai, Sri Lanka, Cape Town) reported at ~20% of consolidated revenue (press coverage, FY25-era); US hotels alone ~10% of consolidated revenue per one report. FY26 West Asia conflict cost ~Rs 40-50 Cr of consolidated revenue. FY26 BRSR (standalone) lists exports as 'Not applicable'.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Per FY26 directors' report: consolidated long-term borrowings (ex-leases) fell to Rs 51.28 Cr at 31-Mar-26 from Rs 224.70 Cr; short-term borrowings nil; standalone long-term borrowings nil; net liquidity Rs 4,293.81 Cr. Rate sensitivity via debt is negligible.

inr_exposure.evidence: Derived estimate: international operations ~20% of consolidated revenue (press reports; not an FY26 AR figure). FY26 consolidated revenue Rs 9,689 Cr (total income Rs 9,971 Cr).

china_plus_one.evidence: FY26 BRSR (standalone): exports 76% of turnover; Q1FY26 consolidated exports ~60%. Company positioned as first non-China source for certain electrolyte additives/semiconductor chemicals and opened a Korea semiconductor-materials plant to build a geographically diversified supply chain. FY26 revenue Rs 13,394 Mn (+33%) attributed mainly to CDMO/pharma intermediates (88% of revenue) rather than explicitly to China+1.

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports 76% of FY26 standalone turnover per FY2025-26 BRSR (overseas-revenue proxy). Hedging policy not found in snippets.

china_plus_one.evidence: FY26 BRSR: exports 9.11% of turnover. Overseas order inflow a record Rs 4,929 Cr in FY26 (of Rs 7,978 Cr total); Middle East ~30% of overseas inflow; international reportedly ~40% of order book. Engineering consultancy exports, no China+1 angle.

govt_capex.evidence: Navratna CPSU under MoPNG; key clients are PSU oil & gas companies (IOCL, HPCL, BPCL, ONGC, GAIL) for refinery/petrochemical capex. FY26 standalone revenue Rs 3,849 Cr (+27.1%); order book Rs 15,109 Cr at Mar-26. Revenue share from government/PSU clients not disclosed in snippets.

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports 9.11% of FY26 turnover per FY2025-26 BRSR (overseas-revenue proxy).
